# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 14 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 14 | **Condition:** heavily damaged

---

**14:1** Blessed are You, O Lord, creator of [...] great deeds and mighty in [...].

**14:2** All things are Your work. You have established [...] wonderful designs

**14:3** and great counsel. Your glory is upon all [...] and the abundance of Your mercies is upon all the sons of Your good pleasure.

**14:4** You have caused them to know [...] and in the mysteries of Your wonder they exalt.

**14:5** [...] for the sake of Your glory You have fashioned [...] the spirits of [...]

**14:6** You have fashioned luminaries for their appointed tasks, and the stars in their circuits,

**14:7** and winds according to their secrets, and lightning and thunder for their service;

**14:8** and the storehouses ordained for their purposes, and snow and hail for [...]

**14:9** [...] and living waters [...] for their seasons, and clouds of rain for [...]

**14:10** [...] they pour out [...] upon the face of [...]

**14:11** You have fashioned spirits [...] luminaries [...] and the laws of the lights for their governance,

**14:12** stars in their paths for the signs and seasons, winds in their storehouses,

**14:13** lightning and thunder for their purposes, and the treasuries [...] that You have prepared for their appointed times,

**14:14** snow and hail for their [...], and dew and rain for [...] their seasons,

**14:15** [...] the foundations of the earth [...] and the depths [...] and the seas [...]

**14:16** [...] and their fullness You have fashioned with wisdom [...] and all that is in them

**14:17** You have established by Your power. The living waters [...] streams and springs [...]

**14:18** [...] for the sons of men and the fruit of [...] for their food,

**14:19** and for all the creatures of the earth and the beasts of the field and the birds of the heavens.

**14:20** All of them You have [...] decreed, and the measure of the rain You have apportioned.

**14:21** [...] and in the appointed time of [...] between light and darkness [...]

**14:22** You have established the dawn by the knowledge of Your heart, and the night watch [...]

**14:23** [...] the morning to [...] the time of darkness, and the cycle of day in its circuit,

**14:24** and the turning of evening and the going out of morning, and appointed times of [...]

**14:25** [...] and the seasons of the year in the turning of their days,

**14:26** and the appointed stations of the moon for their nights, and the cycles of the years and their seasons [...]

**14:27** [...] and the appointed times of light from its source [...] and toward its gathering place,

**14:28** at the dominion of [...] and the turning of the seasons by the laws of the sun,

**14:29** and the appearing of the moon [...] at night [...] for a memorial in its seasons,

**14:30** [...] and the foundations of the earth [...] the expanse of the dry land [...]

**14:31** [...] seas and deeps [...] abysses and [...] the fountains of water [...]

**14:32** [...] and clouds [...] earth and all its produce [...]

**14:33** the fruit of [...] and the trees of [...] and all the harvest of [...]

**14:34** [...] all the foundations of the earth You have set upon [...] the pillar of [...]

**14:35** [...] and without You nothing is done, and nothing is known without Your will.

**14:36** There is none besides You, and none can match Your strength, and nothing compares to Your glory,

**14:37** and Your power has no price.

---
*EMET notes: Column 14 is heavily damaged. The surviving text is a creation hymn praising God for fashioning the cosmos: luminaries, weather, waters, seasons, and all life. Lines 35-37 are a powerful monotheistic declaration preserved almost intact.*
